notes: Quest catalogue for PauliSwap Predict. id 0 is PauliPredictXP.checkIn (on chain); every other id is credited by scripts/qrvm/attester.js through creditQuest. kind daily resets at 00:00 UTC; kind season is credited once per season. rule names are evaluated by pauli-swap-indexer/src/quests.ts; min is in QRL for swap / lp / wrap rules and in XP for predict rules. A day rule counts UTC days on which its inner rule was met; the days need not be consecutive.
